_comment: weapon.c special_dmgval():380-391, reached from uhitm.c hmonas() AT_HUGS with W_ARMC|W_ARM|W_ARMU. A Priest polymorphs into a salamander, which keeps its robe (MZ_HUMAN, humanoid), and hugs a created giant mummy while the robe is uncursed (outermost layer chosen, no roll). It then blesses the robe with holy water and hugs a second giant mummy, which is undead and so hates blessings: special_dmgval() rolls rnd(4) for the robe. Independent of the c-diff-b4 examples.
